'''Seibahn Vabakson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] intelligence operative who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Vabakson offered his services to the Empire, serving as part of the [[Dread Executioners]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]] during the phase of the conflict known as the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seibahn Vabakson was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. He appeared on Oricon, where he was the Basic Gear vendor for the Imperial Agent class. Vabakson and the rest of the class gear vendors at Oricon, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by standardized vendors in Game Update 4.0<ref name="TOR" /> on [[October 20]], [[2015]];<ref name="Patch4">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was replaced by Agent [[Tomms]].<ref name="TOR" />
